# SYNCORA Tally on Mobile

> SYNCORA is a web dashboard for viewing Tally company data connected through the TallyLink Windows connector.

## Product
- View company vouchers, party ledgers, balances and reports on mobile or desktop browsers.
- Sign in, install the Windows connector on the computer running Tally, sync a company and select it in the dashboard.
- Tally and TallyPrime are trademarks of their respective owners. SYNCORA works alongside Tally and does not replace it.
